purpose: Predeclared, stratified (top/middle/bottom) IEO/Atira-mode field sample closing the 3-to-7 searched-null-control gap left by the operator-approved threshold revision (PR #276): ieo's positive count already meets its revised 7/7 threshold, but searched_null (3) still needs 4 more real controls. This batch supplies 6 (a margin buffer above the 4 needed) in case of acquisition failures like the Aten batch's field 7.
selection_method: select_survey_fields.select_fields(jd=2461246.64, mode='ieo', top_n=99999) over the full eligible field set (161 fields), excluding the 59 coordinates already present in data_selection/target_priority_queue.csv (parsed from its notes/selection_rule columns) plus the 3 existing ieo entries in ztf_field_null_outcomes_v3.json plus the 12 Aten-mode stratified fields already used, then taking 2 top-ranked, 2 middle-ranked, and 2 bottom-ranked fields from the remaining 151-field pool.
